title: Canonical term under an extending restriction
statement: Let $\phi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates, and let $\rho,\eta$ be coordinate restrictions such that $\eta$ agrees with $\rho$ wherever $\rho$ is fixed. Suppose each restriction admits at least one compatible term, and the canonical term selected for $\rho$ is compatible with $\eta$. Then the canonical terms selected for $\rho$ and $\eta$ are equal.
hypotheses_covered: A DNF formula on n coordinates
Each of ρ and η has a compatible term
η agrees with ρ at every coordinate where ρ is not free
The canonical term selected for ρ is compatible with η
